Package oel.taskmanager

Class Task

java.lang.Object
oel.taskmanager.Task
public class Task extends Object
Represents a single task in the Task Management System. A task has an immutable unique identifier, a mandatory title, an optional description and a TaskStatus. All mutating operations validate their input, so a Task can never hold a blank title or a null status.
Author:
Muhammad Hassaan Rashid

  • Constructor Details

    • Task

      public Task(int id, String title, String description, TaskStatus status)
      Creates a new task after validating and normalising the input.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the task
      title - the title; must not be null, empty or whitespace-only
      description - the description; null is treated as an empty string
      status - the initial status; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title or status is invalid

    • update

      public void update(String newTitle, String newDescription, TaskStatus newStatus)
      Updates title, description and status in a single atomic step. If any argument is invalid, none of the fields are changed.
      Parameters:
      newTitle - the new title (must not be blank)
      newDescription - the new description (null becomes "")
      newStatus - the new status (must not be null)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title or status is invalid
